failure.message: Linux verification host has no authorized Android arm64 device runner; the official target build is blocked by missing OpenSSL development metadata and NDK r27c

checks.detail: Portable tests verify logical role/name/index mapping, NHWC shape enforcement, and F32 to U8/I8 quantization; Validation commit 27582f5 records the candidate as NCHW/FP32 and is not rewritten.
No Android arm64 runner was available to measure or enforce the 15000 ms target boundary.
The CompiledModel smoke lifecycle is build-verified with a deterministic fake, but no Android device inference was executed.
Validation host golden evidence cannot be relabeled as Android Base adapter output.
Portable tests cover artifact, runtime, device, I/O, and smoke failure stages and preserve Web fallback diagnostics.
Resolved backend, runtime version 2.1.6, official Rust binding 0.1.3, accelerator, artifact identity, I/O plan, and smoke state are machine-readable.
No Android target performance samples were collected.

No Android application package or device-side LiteRT shared-library load was executed. The host has NDK 30.0.14904198 rather than required r27c, and the official Cargo target check stopped in openssl-sys because OpenSSL development metadata is absent.
